name: Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire
insider_take: A magnificent Georgian country estate turned Five-Star sanctuary, where 500 acres of rolling Hampshire countryside meet the legendary Four Seasons touch — pure countryside luxury at its finest.
whats_special: Set within the stunning Dogmersfield Park estate , this converted 18th-century manor house blends historic grandeur with modern indulgence. The hotel sits within the heart of the Hampshire countryside , offering world-class spa facilities, championship-standard golf, and direct access to some of England's most picturesque walking trails. Its proximity to both London (just 45 miles away) and the historic city of Winchester makes it a perfect escape without feeling remote.
pro_tip: Book a Courtyard Room for the most immersive estate experience — the views over the manicured grounds and Tundry Pond are absolutely breathtaking, especially at sunrise. Ask the concierge about private fly-fishing sessions on the estate's own lake.
dont_miss: The Spa at Four Seasons Hampshire is a destination in itself — featuring an indoor pool, hydrotherapy circuit, and treatments inspired by the English countryside. Also, be sure to explore the estate's ornamental lakes and woodland trails on foot or by bicycle. History buffs will love that the estate dates back to the Domesday Book of 1086 .
pros: Iconic luxury hotel with renowned Four Seasons service standards
Prime London location near Hyde Park and Mayfair shopping
Elegant Georgian architecture with sophisticated interiors
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Bustling central location may not suit guests seeking tranquility
